articles.summary: Two Grove GMK5150XL all-terrain cranes are supporting critical lifting operations on Azerbaijan’s AZFEN gas platform.The advanced lifting performance and class-leading boom length of the GMK5150XL cranes enable precise, high-reach work in space-constrained sites.
articles.title: Two Grove GMK5150XL cranes power offshore platform construction in Azerbaijan

articles.summary: The expansion of the Rapid Response Shop strengthens Manitowoc’s focus on customer support, providing a wide range of structural crane repairs.The expanded facility gives customers a place to send cranes or components for structural work that exceeds what can be handled in the field.
articles.title: Manitowoc expands U.S. aftermarket support with enhanced Rapid Response Shop

articles.summary: The new Grove GMK5250XL-1 impresses with its long main boom, compact dimensions, VIAB turbo retarder clutch, and interchangeable counterweight slabs.It was handed over at the Manitowoc facility in Breda in the Netherlands and is now working across Germany and the Netherlands, offering efficiency, flexibility, and future-ready capabilities.
articles.title: Wagenborg Nedlift makes strong addition to the fleet with a new Grove GMK5250XL-1 for projects in Germany and the Netherlands

articles.summary: A Potain MDT 489 topless tower crane is leading work on a new residential project in Iceland.The development is being built largely from precast concrete, so the project owner sought the most efficient lifting solution.Local Potain dealer DS Lausnir recommended the Potain MDT 489, which has the strength and reach to cover the whole site from a single location.
articles.title: First Potain MDT 489 in Iceland drives new construction thinking on Reykjavik project

articles.summary: Potain topless tower crane enhances logistics on complex alpine jobsite.Advanced Crane Control System (CCS) improves efficiency and commissioning time.
articles.title: Potain MDT 269 supports major hydropower plant upgrade in northern Italy

articles.summary: K.I.G.O., the local Potain dealer for Serbia, has supplied nine cranes to the multi-structure complex being built close to the capital, Belgrade.There are eight Potain topless models on the project, plus a self-erecting crane.Potain’s topless engineering means multiple cranes can overlap on the seven-building development.
articles.title: Potain topless cranes coordinate seamlessly to create mixed-use development in Serbia

articles.summary: Two Potain tower cranes are supporting distinct but coordinated construction efforts at Froedtert Hospital in Milwaukee — a new parking structure, served by a Potain MD 559, and a hospital expansion, supported by a Potain MD 569.Reynolds Rigging & Crane Service is delivering full in house planning, assembly, disassembly, and crane operations for both projects.
articles.title: Two scopes, two cranes, one campus: Potain tower cranes support major hospital-campus build in Milwaukee

articles.summary: Three Potain MC 480 tower cranes deliver reliable performance, with no unplanned downtime, to support the construction of the Luding Dadu River Bridge under challenging high-wind, canyon conditions.Durable Potain design and low maintenance requirements support extended service life across multiple projects.
articles.title: Three Potain MC 480 tower cranes power construction of Luding Dadu River Bridge in China
